rationale: At VWAP (-0.13%), mid-way between support 305.19 and resistance 316.77, weak short composite (-0.35, 40%) contradicted by a very strong orderbook bid (+0.68) and +5.8% rel strength. Shorting into that bid at mid-range is the classic late-short-into-support loser; long fights the composite with Monday CPI + bank-earnings gap risk over the weekend. No clean 1.5R. Loss of 313.65 validates the short toward 305.

Hawkish Fed under Warsh (~61% odds of a Sept HIKE); equities near highs, semis leading, oil weakness a tailwind but a 'sell-the-rip on hawkish surprise' backdrop. Crypto is the soft spot: BTC ~$64k, dominance ~48%, SOL ~$80-85. HEAVY catalyst week: Mon Jul 14 08:30 ET June CPI + JPM/GS Q2 earnings same morning (vol spike), Tue PPI, Wed Retail Sales; FOMC Jul 28-29. Trade SMALLER into CPI. Positioning: long/short ratios lopsided LONG across almost every name (contrarian short/squeeze-down risk), funding ~0. Best own-story shorts: EWY, TSM, MU. Cleanest relative-strength longs but crowded: SOL, AAPL. Avoid fresh MSTR risk (lagging BTC beta, no edge). Tokenized-equity names carry weekend/overnight gap risk into Monday CPI since their underlyings are closed.
